newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 14.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 14.

text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.S. House of Representatives plans to read a draft law on Thursday urging the acceptance of the Baltic countries and Romania to NATO when they have fulfilled the alliance's criteria.
- Lithuanian diplomats intend to hand over the latest updated information on Lithuania to the Commission of the European Union before May 15.
